text: Implemented injected ManagedBatchExecutor and thin SlurmSite.fromCapabilities. Durable controller now exposes inspect/observeSubmission; Sojourn admits through controller.submit before caching, maps durable digest mismatch to typed Conflict, resumes Existing attempts without resubmission, projects status/freshness/cancellation from ManagedAttempt, and has no scheduler.observe call. RetrySafety stays on the lowered request; ResultAttachment fences AttemptEpoch. Evidence: scala-slurm managed 61/61 (created/existing/conflict, observation projection, acceptance unknown, retry epoch, races, reopen, cancellation/reconciliation); ResultAttachment stale-epoch tests; Sojourn SlurmCapabilitiesSuite 2/2; grep confirms no direct scheduler.observe or envelope re-decode.
